messages:
tessa: FYI: ran into a nasty edge with streaming in the ruby sdk. On short responses the client sometimes drops the final chunk when the server closes immediately after [DONE].

mike: oof. which endpoint and SDK version?

tessa: /v1/chat/stream, ruby-sdk 0.2.1. Quick curl repro:

```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/chat/stream?model=mini"
```

server sends: data: {"chunk":"ok"}
data: [DONE]
 then socket FIN. client sometimes emits nothing for 'ok'.

jing: Could be readline vs raw recv differences. Ruby's SSE reader uses IO#gets which can block until delimiter; if FIN arrives before delimiter we might treat it as nil.

tessa: Right. I traced it: when FIN arrives, the leftover buffer is returned by readpartial but our event loop only constructs events on seeing a blank-line separator. If the trailing newline is missing we drop it.

mike: That's the same class of bug we saw in python/node. We fixed by treating EOF as a delimiter. Is parity across SDKs documented?

jing: It's spotty. We have notes in the go/python changelogs but ruby missed it. We should add a short compatibility paragraph in the SDK guide about EOF handling and reconnect semantics.

tessa: I put up a tiny patch to append an implicit "\n\n" when read returns EOF and process the leftover buffer. Also added a sample in samples/streaming/ruby that splits recv into ["data: {\"chunk\":\"o","k\"}\n","data: [DONE]\n"] to simulate split TCP segments.

sdk-bot: PR #5233 opened by tessa - fix(sdk-ruby): treat EOF as SSE delimiter; add split-segment sample and tests

mike: can you add a quickstart blurb about "best-effort idempotency"? i.e., clients should dedupe final tokens if they may retry after reconnect.

jing: Agree. Also add test variants for CRLF vs LF-only servers. We had a weird one where apache LB converted endings.

tessa: Added docs + tests, plus a short Cookbook note: "Handling partial chunks & reconnects" with small code snippet and recommended backoff window for idempotent retries.

sdk-bot: PR #5233 merged to main by mike - summary: sdk-ruby: fix EOF handling in SSE reader; samples + docs updated

mike: Nice. Can we add a health-check in the quickstart app that warns when server sends no final newline? would help onboarding.

jing: Might be useful as a debug mode only. I'll add a --sse-debug flag to the ruby sample app to log raw bytes and newline patterns.

tessa: Verified in staging. reconnects no longer cause missing final tokens. QA ran sample app with 500 rapid reconnect cycles. no regressions. thanks all :raised_hands:
